*SBP-Octamer Plate Preparation*

Octamer concentration \= 4.65 ug/uL \= 4650 ng/uL

Number of experiments \= 15

Volume per experiment \= 1.8 uL

Volume needed per well \= 30 uL

Prepare 30 ng/uL octamer with 30 uL per well ⇒ 30 X 400 X 30 \= 360 ug SBP-octamer

Take 78 uL of original octamer and make up solution to 12000 uL (add 360 uL 100 mM TCEP \+ 11562 uL of refolding buffer:glycerol (1:1))

Split 125 uL of the octamer mix into each well of a 96-well plate. Use the Beckman to aliquot 30 per well of an octamer plate.
